fields.description:
Outcome and context

Emily's Sep 2026 feedback (Wagertech Notes / Questions) confirms BA (Brand Ambassador) creation stays manual on both sides for now — Jumpr and WagerTech each create the record by hand rather than through an automated CMS feed, at least to start. The BA External ID field already exists on the BA record (BUILD-205 / BA-4) as the key used to map a BA to its CMS-side identity, so the manual process needs to reference and populate that field consistently.

Current state

BUILD-205 (BA-4, WAGR-183) built BA External ID, BA Slug, and Primary Agency Site as read-only, CMS-sourced identity fields, sourced upstream via the CMS the same way Player records are. No automated intake or sync from the CMS into Salesforce for BA creation has been built or scoped — BAs are created manually today.

Proposed solution

  1. Document the manual BA creation steps for both sides: what WagerTech/CMS provides (the BA External ID and any other CMS-side identity values) and what Jumpr/the BA admin enters into Salesforce when standing up a new BA record.

  2. Confirm where the BA External ID value comes from operationally (CMS export, manual lookup, etc.) so it's entered consistently and matches the CMS record it maps to.

  3. Fold this into the existing BA user setup runbook (BUILD-221 / WAGR-186) so a new BA's record creation and User/login setup are captured in one place.

Acceptance criteria

  1. A written, repeatable process exists for creating a new BA record manually, referencing the CMS for the BA External ID.

  2. The process states clearly that no automated CMS-to-Salesforce creation exists yet.

  3. The process is linked from or folded into the BA user setup runbook.

Out of scope

Building an automated CMS-to-Salesforce sync for BA creation — noted as a future possibility, not in scope here.

Dependencies

Depends on BUILD-205 — Brand Ambassador: CMS Identity Fields (WAGR-183).

Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Emily Vandenberg), reviewed Sep 2026: "BA Creation - Manual on both sides to start (refer to CMS to pull in the BA External Id)." https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ShxHdE6kxblGnih7VQzXbBx1eL0sC6XAD-fk8H6V9yw/edit?tab=t.0
